took: the part of you that knew you were good enough
regret: every time she looked over to see if she'd done all right, they let her wonder, when it would have cost them one word
unsaid: You were always good enough. I just never said it.
do: Once a day for seven days, let one thing of hers go out as it is, with no apology on it: the message sent without a third read, the dish served without saying it didn't turn out, the opinion said without 'but what do I know.'
